In October, 532 paid leads came into HubSpot: 336.5 from Google Ads and 195.5 from Meta Ads. On November 5, 67 of them were in Pending Documents (52 Google Ads, 15 Meta Ads) and 17 were already enrolled (16 Google Ads, 1 Meta Ads). Google Ads spent $86,729.38, or $257.74 per HubSpot lead, and Meta Ads spent $66,767.20, or $341.52 per HubSpot lead.

01Notes

Reading this report

Short notes before the numbers.

Scope

Paid leads only

This report counts only contacts who came from a Google Ads or Meta Ads click. Organic search, direct visits, referrals and other unpaid sources are not included.

Platform

Each lead counted once

Each lead goes to the platform HubSpot recorded as its original source: a Google Ads campaign, or Facebook and Instagram for Meta Ads. When the source is a page of the website, the ad click saved on the contact decides. A lead who clicked ads on both platforms counts as half a lead for each, so Google Ads and Meta Ads always add up to the total.

Two counts

HubSpot leads and platform conversions

Part 1 counts leads in HubSpot. Parts 2 and 3 show conversions as each platform reports them: Google Ads conversions come from the new-lead events HubSpot sends to Google, and Meta conversions are the results Meta reports for the lead event on the website. They come from different systems, so they do not match one to one.

Timing

Status as of November 5, 2026

Families take longer to enroll than the month this report covers. The number of October leads is final and will not change. Their enrollment status will: Pending Documents and Enrolled Students show where each lead stood on November 5, 2026, and both are likely to grow in the coming months as families finish enrolling.
